title: Jesus Appears by the Sea of Tiberias, Peter Restored

questions.question: By what other name is the Sea of Galilee also called in John 21?
options: The Sea of Tiberias
The Sea of Gennesaret
The Sea of Kinnereth
The Dead Sea
questions.explanation: John 21:1 (ESV): "After this Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples by the Sea of Tiberias..."

questions.question: Peter said "I am going fishing." Several disciples went with him and fished all night. How much did they catch?
options: Nothing
A small net-full entirely
Two boatloads safely
A hundred and fifty fish directly
questions.explanation: John 21:3 (ESV): "but that night they caught nothing."

questions.question: Standing on the beach at dawn, Jesus called out and told them to cast their net on which side of the boat?
options: The right side
The left side
Behind the boat
Straight down below
questions.explanation: John 21:6 (ESV): "He said to them, 'Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.'"

questions.question: Which disciple first recognized it was Jesus standing on the shore?
options: The disciple whom Jesus loved
Simon Peter
Thomas
Andrew
questions.explanation: John 21:7 (ESV): "That disciple whom Jesus loved therefore said to Peter, 'It is the Lord!'"

questions.question: When Peter heard it was the Lord, what did he do?
options: He put on his outer garment and threw himself into the sea to swim to Jesus
He shouted joyfully from the boat entirely
He rowed quickly toward shore securely
He fell to his knees in the boat in worship
questions.correctAnswer: He put on his outer garment and threw himself into the sea to swim to Jesus
questions.explanation: John 21:7 (ESV): "When Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment, for he was stripped for work, and threw himself into the sea."

questions.question: How many large fish were in the net the disciples dragged to shore?
questions.explanation: John 21:11 (ESV): "Simon Peter went aboard and hauled the net ashore, full of large fish, 153 of them."

questions.question: What meal had Jesus already prepared for the disciples on the shore?
options: A charcoal fire with fish and bread already on it
A feast of lamb and unleavened bread
A table with wine, cheese, and olives
A Passover meal prepared at dawn
questions.correctAnswer: A charcoal fire with fish and bread already on it
questions.explanation: John 21:9 (ESV): "When they got out on land, they saw a charcoal fire in place, with fish laid out on it, and bread."

questions.question: Jesus asked Peter three times "Do you love me?" corresponding to Peter's three denials. What did Jesus tell Peter to do each time Peter affirmed his love?
options: "Feed my lambs / Tend my sheep / Feed my sheep."
"Forgive your enemies / Pray constantly / Bear the cross."
"Go fish for men / Baptize all nations / Teach all countries."
"Keep the commandments / Love one another / Follow me only."
questions.correctAnswer: "Feed my lambs / Tend my sheep / Feed my sheep."
questions.explanation: John 21:15-17 (ESV): Jesus said "Feed my lambs"... "Tend my sheep"... "Feed my sheep."

questions.question: Peter was grieved the third time Jesus asked "Do you love me?" What was his response?
options: "Lord, you know everything; you know that I love you."
"I have sworn it twice, is that not enough?"
"Lord, you know I denied you, but I truly repent."
"You know my heart better than I know it myself."
questions.correctAnswer: "Lord, you know everything; you know that I love you."
questions.explanation: John 21:17 (ESV): "Lord, you know everything; you know that I love you."

questions.question: Jesus told Peter: "Truly, truly, I say to you, when you were young, you used to dress yourself and walk wherever you wanted, but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you do not want to go." What did John note this signified?
options: This he said to show by what kind of death he was to glorify God
That Peter would travel to many distant lands
That Peter would be imprisoned but later released
That Peter would grow weak with old age entirely
questions.correctAnswer: This he said to show by what kind of death he was to glorify God
questions.explanation: John 21:19 (ESV): "(This he said to show by what kind of death he was to glorify God.)"

questions.question: After speaking of Peter's future death, what two words did Jesus simply say to Peter?
options: "Follow me."
"Fear not."
"Go fish."
"Love well."
questions.explanation: John 21:19 (ESV): "And after saying this he said to him, 'Follow me.'"

questions.question: Peter asked Jesus about the beloved disciple following: "Lord, what about this man?" What was Jesus' answer?
options: "If it is my will that he remain until I come, what is that to you? You follow me!"
"He will suffer greatly as you will suffer."
"He will build the church in my name safely."
"His fate is hidden entirely from you completely."
questions.correctAnswer: "If it is my will that he remain until I come, what is that to you? You follow me!"
questions.explanation: John 21:22 (ESV): "Jesus said to him, 'If it is my will that he remain until I come, what is that to you? You follow me!'"

questions.question: A rumor spread among the brothers that the beloved disciple would not die. What did John clarify about what Jesus actually said?
options: Jesus did not say he would not die, but "If it is my will that he remain until I come, what is that to you?"
Jesus promised he would survive entirely until the end entirely
Jesus guaranteed no beloved disciple would die at all
Jesus said nothing of the sort about the beloved disciple
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus did not say he would not die, but "If it is my will that he remain until I come, what is that to you?"
questions.explanation: John 21:23 (ESV): "Yet Jesus did not say to him that he was not to die, but, 'If it is my will that he remain until I come, what is that to you?'"

questions.question: Who does John indicate is the disciple who testifies about these things and who wrote them?
options: The disciple whom Jesus loved
Simon Peter specifically
John the son of Zebedee by name
An unnamed witness only
questions.explanation: John 21:24 (ESV): "This is the disciple who is bearing witness about these things, and who has written these things, and we know that his testimony is true."

questions.question: The final verse of John says that if all the things Jesus did were written down, even the world itself could not contain what?
options: the books that would be written
the glory that would fill it
the miracles that occurred
the names of those he healed
questions.correctAnswer: the books that would be written
questions.explanation: John 21:25 (ESV): "Now there are also many other things that Jesus did. Were every one of them to be written, I suppose that the world itself could not contain the books that would be written."

key_verse_text: Jesus said to him, "If it is my will that he remain until I come, what is that to you? You follow me!"
